Preface

In today's fast-paced enterprise landscape, managing IT infrastructure—encompassing hardware assets, licensed software subscriptions, and internal technical helpdesk operations—is vital to maintaining operational continuity and data governance. Manual spreadsheets and disparate tracking systems inevitably lead to license over-allocation, delayed SLA response times, untracked hardware transfers, and non-compliance risks during audits.

This project report chronicles the end-to-end design, implementation, and rigorous verification of the IT Asset & Support Desk Management System (AssetDesk). The system was developed as a modern, unified full-stack web platform implementing Role-Based Access Control (RBAC), strict status transition state machines, priority-driven SLA deadlines, atomic concurrency controls, and immutable audit trails.

The report is structured in accordance with the official VICAIT internship project guidelines. It thoroughly details system requirements, functional decomposition, architectural designs, data models, implementation code snippets, automated testing results, and future enhancements. It serves as a comprehensive technical record of the engineering rigor and operational principles applied throughout the 15-week internship tenure.
